model_name: trial-10 trial-01 generator + K562-only same-target transfer a=0.197
description: Attribution control for trial-08: identical to it except that the CD4 source is removed. Cells are sampled exactly as in trial-01 (Poisson counts at library sizes resampled from each context's own control cells, around the context's control profile shifted by the predicted effect; no control cell is copied). The predicted effect of a target is its measured CRISPRi response in K562 genome-wide Perturb-seq (Replogle et al. 2022), with K562's mean response removed, scaled by 0.197. No perturbed cell of the official contexts is used.
